question: Should OpenClaw retain failed inbound payloads and metadata for the existing dead-letter TTL and permit an operator to replay the original event ID through the new CLI?
rationale: This is a persistent sensitive-data-retention and message-redelivery policy choice, not a mechanical correctness question that CI can settle.

options.title: Approve bounded recovery retention
options.body: Accept retention within the existing cap and TTL, provided the CLI contract documents replay and legacy unrecoverable rows.

options.title: Keep diagnostics without replay
options.body: Expose counts and failure diagnostics while continuing to scrub payloads and omitting manual resubmission.

options.title: Require a narrower retention policy
options.body: Retain only the minimum non-sensitive diagnostic fields or a reduced retention window before exposing recovery commands.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded recovery retention
recommendation.body: Accept retention within the existing cap and TTL, provided the CLI contract documents replay and legacy unrecoverable rows.
